summary: Out-of-bounds skier at Snowmass Ski Area (near the run known as "The Wall") fell into a river and was reported in distress around 3 p.m.; Snowmass Ski Patrol followed a single set of ski tracks with GPS coordinates and, joined by Mountain Rescue Aspen personnel, located the uninjured skier in the West Willow drainage; the party walked down to T-Lazy 7 Ranch, arriving around 6 p.m.
location: Out-of-bounds below "The Wall", Snowmass Ski Area to West Willow drainage
responding_agency: Snowmass Ski Patrol; Mountain Rescue Aspen
notes: Date inferred as January 14, 2023: the January 16 report describes the operation as Saturday afternoon. The reported location is Snowmass Ski Area / West Willow drainage, not Snowmass Mountain.
